primary.title: Notebooks
primary.author: Leonardo da Vinci
primary.rationale: Leonardo's extensive notebooks contain his scientific observations, artistic theories, and personal reflections. They are a fundamental primary source for understanding his mind and work.

primary.title: Treatise on Painting
primary.author: Leonardo da Vinci
primary.rationale: A compilation of Leonardo's writings on art theory and practice, particularly perspective, light, and shadow. While compiled posthumously, it directly reflects his artistic teachings.

secondary.title: Leonardo da Vinci: The Biography
secondary.author: Walter Isaacson
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and widely acclaimed biography that draws on Leonardo's notebooks and other primary sources to provide a detailed account of his life and multifaceted genius.

secondary.title: Leonardo da Vinci
secondary.author: Martin Kemp
secondary.rationale: A leading Leonardo scholar, Kemp offers an authoritative overview of Leonardo's life, work, and intellectual context, incorporating recent scholarship.

secondary.title: Leonardo da Vinci: Experience, Experiment, Design
secondary.author: Luke Syson
secondary.rationale: Published in conjunction with a major exhibition, this scholarly catalog explores Leonardo's diverse activities and innovations through essays by leading experts.

suggestions.notes: Leonardo's primary writings are primarily his notebooks, which are vast and cover a wide range of topics. The 'Treatise on Painting' is a posthumous compilation. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly rigor and recent publication dates.
